@relaydock.credentials.secret-service
role Store opaque credential bytes in the Linux Secret Service through cancellable D-Bus sessions, unlock prompts, and bounded public errors.
owns Linux credential backend, Secret Service prompt lifecycle, credential byte zeroing
excludes credential namespace policy, provider credential interpretation
invariant Credential values are copied at ownership boundaries and cleared after transport use. Remote D-Bus error bodies never enter public errors.
risk privacy
rel test>relaydock.credentials.secret-service.contract

@relaydock.credentials.secret-service.contract
role Verify Linux Secret Service create, unlock, read, delete, cancellation, byte clearing, and remote error redaction behavior.
